subject.title: improve(agents): reduce per-turn conversation metadata tokens

question: Should OpenClaw accept this prompt-schema reduction, including moving bot-mention guidance into the stable system prompt, after reviewing real channel/model behavior?
rationale: The change is bounded and test-backed, but prompt content and placement are behavioral contracts for model reasoning that snapshot assertions alone cannot fully establish.

options.title: Request focused live proof

options.title: Accept the test-backed prompt change
options.body: Merge based on the focused regression suite and snapshots if the owner considers the existing prompt-boundary coverage sufficient for this low-risk optimization.
